Sure! One way to make meditation a daily habit is to schedule it at the same time each day. For example, set aside 10-15 minutes every morning or evening to practice mindfulness or meditation. Instead of trying to meditate for 30 minutes at a time, start with just 5-10 minutes and gradually increase the time as you get more comfortable with the practice. You could also try using a meditation app or guided meditation videos on YouTube to help you stay on track and offer guidance as you're getting started. Finally, if you miss a day or two, don't beat yourself up about it. Try not to see it as a failure, but rather as an opportunity to start fresh and try again tomorrow.
